title: Unused `v: ^View` parameter in draw_family_wash and draw_family_wash_disc
detail: Neither proc body references `v`; the parameter is dead weight on both new wash procs and misleads readers into expecting view state use.
recommended_fix: Drop the `v` parameter from both procs (they are pure dst/color functions), or use it if scale-dependent behavior was intended.

title: Wash alignment depends on duplicated dst/index/target computation around sprite_blit
evidence:
dst, ok := sprite_blit_dst(&v.sprites, sprite_index_puck(port_capacity), c, sprite_puck_target(v, port_capacity))
		sprite_blit(&v.sprites, sprite_index_puck(port_capacity), c, sprite_puck_target(v, port_capacity))
detail: sprite_index_puck and sprite_puck_target are each called twice per router (same pattern in draw_building for idx/target). If sprite_blit's internal rect ever diverges from sprite_blit_dst, the wash silently misaligns.
recommended_fix: Have sprite_blit return its dst rect (or accept a precomputed dst) so the wash consumes the blit's own geometry.

title: Unrelated committed .pyc deletion not in the PR body's Files list
evidence:
diff --git a/tools/__pycache__/derive_a11y_palettes.cpython-313.pyc b/tools/__pycache__/derive_a11y_palettes.cpython-313.pyc
deleted file mode 100644
index f807a4d..0000000
detail: Deleting a stray build artifact is housekeeping, not node clarity; the PR body's Files section does not mention it, so the change is unreviewed by its own documentation.
recommended_fix: Move artifact deletions to a separate hygiene commit or list the deletion in the PR body's Files section.

title: palcheck puck-LED floor silently halved from >10 to >5
evidence:
-	check(count_exact(calm, LED_GREEN) > 10, "puck LEDs", count_exact(calm, LED_GREEN))
+	check(count_exact(calm, LED_GREEN) > 5, "puck LEDs", count_exact(calm, LED_GREEN))
detail: The LED color re-pin is explained in comments; the halved detection floor is not. Weakening a canary floor without a stated measurement invites silent LED regressions.
recommended_fix: State the measured washed-LED pixel count justifying the new floor, or keep the floor proportional to the measured value.

title: PR body claims 4% wash inset; the disc wash uses 6%
evidence:
(rect for buildings, disc for pucks; 4% inset keeps the silhouette edge)
...
	r := min(dst.width, dst.height) * 0.5 * 0.94
detail: Rect wash uses 0.92 (4% per side) but the puck disc uses radius factor 0.94, a 6% inset — the PR body's single 4% figure contradicts the disc code.
recommended_fix: Align the disc factor with the documented inset or correct the PR body to state 4% rect / 6% disc.
